nodes.label: BrandLogo artwork pipeline
nodes.rationale: Source SVG geometry is preserved while a generator produces shared UI artwork and four zone-specific favicons.

nodes.label: Idempotent Bag Filter batches
nodes.rationale: Canonical actor-key-payload identity allows safe retries and rejects mismatched payloads with 409.

nodes.label: R22 document API
nodes.rationale: Consume Return and Picklist are atomic multi-item documents. DECIMAL quantities are strings and removed stock-location endpoints return 410.
nodes.source_location: ## Consumable Room v1.1 — R22 satu stok

nodes.label: Session identity and exact origin
nodes.rationale: The server derives identity from session cookies and internal service authentication. Browser actor headers are not accepted.

nodes.label: Legacy Vinext Cloudflare D1 export
nodes.rationale: The original export is a historical reference. Authentication and transaction integrity required replacement before extraction into v2.

nodes.label: Whole batch cancellation
nodes.rationale: Scoped Bag Filter admins cancel a complete batch with a reason. Original records remain available and valid installation ranking is recomputed.

nodes.label: Fixed point atomic stock documents
nodes.rationale: Bigint arithmetic, deterministic row locks, idempotency and server-owned numbering keep stock and ledger consistent under concurrent retries.

nodes.label: HAC SAC and mandatory Cost Center
nodes.norm_label: hac sac and mandatory cost center
nodes.rationale: The November 5 correction replaces the historical HEC label. The internal hec field remains for compatibility and Picklist Cost Center is required after trimming.

nodes.label: Picklist K3 auto enrollment
nodes.rationale: A new inventory entry receives confirmed opening zero and its receipt in the same transaction. Existing uncounted stock must be counted by an admin.

nodes.label: R22 single shared stock
nodes.rationale: Role-only grants give every authorized user the same stock and document visibility. HAC/SAC is a work destination, distinct from the removed stock locations.

nodes.label: Warehouse R22 Client material flow
nodes.rationale: SAP Warehouse Picklist receipts add stock while Consume and Return documents handle client movements. Location-scoped examples in this historical brief are superseded by the current PRD.

nodes.label: Native Mac development setup
nodes.rationale: Native pinned Node, independent Docker resources and HTTPS HMR must be verified on the Mac. Git synchronizes committed source while environment and database state stay local.

nodes.label: Portable schema and data fingerprint
nodes.rationale: Snapshots preserve BIGINT DECIMAL Unicode and UTC and check foreign keys. Raw restore must match before migration and before limited target-only session revocation.

nodes.label: Single writer database cutover
nodes.rationale: Freeze source writers, restore a private logical dump into an empty target, verify fingerprints, then accept the VPS as the only operational writer.

nodes.label: CI verified full SHA release
nodes.rationale: GitHub validates the exact release commit. The existing workflow has no VPS deployment job, so OpenClaw deploys a pinned SHA with explicit maintenance and checks.

nodes.label: Database migration checkpoints M0 M8
nodes.rationale: Transfer package, empty target, raw restore, reconciliation, target session revocation, owner acceptance and recovery evidence are separate checkpoints.

nodes.label: Deployment checkpoints C0 C12
nodes.rationale: Staging before DNS, public HTTPS, owner login and backup readiness have distinct reported states and must reflect actual checks.

nodes.label: R22 production backup rehearsal
nodes.rationale: Restore the current VPS backup to a separate MySQL drill, test preflight migration rerun and reconciliation, then repeat backup while production writers are stopped.

nodes.label: Private atomic naming CSV import
nodes.rationale: Dry-run is default. Apply validates the whole UTF-8 CSV, preserves empty fields and locked units, and rejects a replay that would overwrite later manual changes.

nodes.label: R22 single room preflight
nodes.rationale: Noncanonical inventory ledger documents or conflicting R22 configuration stop the upgrade for review. The procedure never silently merges balances.

nodes.label: VPS resource budget and serial builds
nodes.norm_label: vps resource budget and serial builds
nodes.rationale: Bounded runtime resources and serial image builds protect existing VPS websites. Available memory and disk must be measured before release work.

nodes.label: Host and Docker Nginx TLS topology
nodes.norm_label: host and docker nginx tls topology
nodes.rationale: Host Nginx owns public 80 and 443. The Docker gateway binds loopback and uses a separately trusted backend certificate with verification enabled.

nodes.label: Additive R22 metadata migration
nodes.rationale: Migration 0002 adds document metadata and snapshots while preserving historical quantities, IDs and packs. Legacy conversion factors require explicit review.

nodes.label: Deterministic document lock ordering
nodes.rationale: Lock the internal room, sorted material IDs, inventory, idempotency and sequence consistently. Validate all lines before writes and retry only recognized transient lock failures.

nodes.label: Application context sidebar navigation
nodes.rationale: Only the active application expands operational submenus. Shared shell navigation, rail flyouts and mobile drawers retain role-specific access.

nodes.label: Proportional count chart and compact Portal
nodes.norm_label: proportional count chart and compact portal
nodes.rationale: Zero values remain zero and extreme quarter distributions keep their true scale. A compact Portal summary shares primitives with the full application dashboard.

nodes.label: Workspace package boundaries
nodes.rationale: Contracts, domain cores, server guards and shared UI are separated so apps can be built independently and operational data stays in domain databases.

nodes.label: Three database backup and restore
nodes.rationale: The backup sidecar verifies compressed dumps and retains fourteen days. Recovery needs offsite copies, a separate target and business reconciliation.

nodes.label: Data compatible application rollback
nodes.rationale: After cancellation or R22 transactions exist, older readers and writers may interpret preserved data incorrectly. Compatibility must be established before restarting them.

nodes.label: Dynamic Docker upstream DNS
nodes.rationale: Shared upstream zones and Docker DNS resolution prevent a recreated application IP from routing JSON APIs to another application.

nodes.label: Active installation age and yearly replacements
nodes.norm_label: active installation age and yearly replacements
nodes.rationale: Current age follows the latest valid installation while yearly replacements count each valid installation event by WIB date. Cancelled batches are excluded.

nodes.label: Six equipment coordinate catalog
nodes.rationale: The catalog has 18,784 physical bag positions with equipment-specific side labels, orientation, row counts and stiffener gaps.

nodes.label: Centralized Auth SSO guards
nodes.rationale: Nginx auth_request and server guards both validate current account and grant state. Absolute eight-hour database sessions fail closed when Auth is unavailable.

nodes.label: Separate transaction chart semantics
nodes.rationale: R22 charts count documents and standalone opening adjustments. Bag Filter charts count installed positions. Current condition KPIs remain independent of selected chart year.

nodes.label: Reversible overlays and momentum gestures
nodes.rationale: Symmetric close transitions preserve content and focus. Pointer samples, momentum, rubber-band and spring release support drawer gestures with reduced-motion adaptations.

nodes.label: Shared semantic theme tokens
nodes.rationale: Tokens, base, components, app and utilities layers provide consistent light dark system themes without external fonts or UI dependencies.
nodes.source_location: # UI refresh v2 — Plant Area System

nodes.label: Disposable MySQL and HTTPS QA
nodes.rationale: R22 validation includes 33 MySQL checks, 17 HTTPS browser scenarios and a three-database restore with 27 table fingerprints on isolated resources.
nodes.source_location: ## Consumable Room v1.1 — R22 satu stok, 2 November 2026

nodes.label: Validation evidence and historical boundaries
nodes.rationale: Each dated entry distinguishes local fixture results, CI evidence, private artifacts and deployment or operator acceptance that remain outside that check.

nodes.label: plant-v2-dev isolated development
nodes.rationale: Separate project, volume, ports and credentials protect the frozen source archive and production.

nodes.label: Portal Auth Bag Filter Consumables
nodes.rationale: Four independently built applications share one HTTPS origin, SSO and workspace packages.

nodes.label: Organization certificate authority
nodes.rationale: Deployment certificates must match PUBLIC_ORIGIN. Organization CA is specified for LAN or VPN deployment, with self-signed certificates for isolated local testing.

nodes.label: tokens.css
nodes.rationale: CSS custom properties centralize palette, themed semantics, geometry, motion, typography, spacing and data visualization styles.

nodes.label: Design system cascade layers
nodes.rationale: The declared cascade order is tokens, base, components, app, then utilities.

nodes.label: Higher contrast token overrides
nodes.rationale: Higher contrast preferences strengthen divider and muted text tokens and make overlay fill solid.

nodes.label: Reduced transparency overlay fill
nodes.rationale: Reduced transparency preference switches overlay fill to the current solid surface token.

nodes.label: Inter and system font type scale
nodes.norm_label: inter and system font type scale
nodes.rationale: Self-hosted Inter variable font (--font-sans), normalized weights (400/500/600), and rem type/leading scales retain a user-controlled root size.

nodes.label: Accessible design tokens
nodes.rationale: System fonts, rem typography and spacing, and contrast-safe data series support browser text settings and operational readability.

nodes.label: Momentum-aware drawer gestures
nodes.rationale: Use velocity projection, hysteresis, rubber-banding and a critically damped continuation for direct manipulation.

nodes.label: Portal operational hub
nodes.rationale: Replace duplicated dashboards and navigation with conditional attention items and one consistent summary per permitted application.

nodes.label: Reversible cart feedback
nodes.rationale: Highlight additions, offer five-second row-removal undo, and keep the mobile save action reachable.

nodes.label: ShellSkeleton navigation fallback
nodes.rationale: Keep the sidebar and topbar visible while server navigation loads destination content.

nodes.label: Bag age map and selection
nodes.rationale: Age buckets and a 1260-day warning notch provide consistent meaning across themes and non-color cues.

nodes.label: November equipment page refinements
nodes.rationale: PRD v2 and UI theme supersede earlier session-card and selection-ring details.

nodes.label: Reversible shared overlays
nodes.rationale: Exit follows entry, focus returns after closing, and interrupted transitions resume from the displayed position.

nodes.label: Immediate stock filters and preserved results
nodes.norm_label: immediate stock filters and preserved results
nodes.rationale: Debounce text search only and retain prior rows while loading to remove artificial input latency and layout jumps.

nodes.label: Inter v4.1 Self-Hosted Font Asset
nodes.rationale: Documents official Inter v4.1 variable WOFF2 asset and SIL OFL 1.1 license bundled in @plant/ui.
